name: Brendan McKeldin Adams
personality: Described as a cuddly koala bear
notable_stories: Described as a cuddly koala bear who popped a slug into his mouth while helping his mother weed the garden
Once attempted to run away from home during his third birthday party by walking down the beach

Worked for Gerald Martin General Contractor in New Mexico. Through this work, met a State of New Mexico representative who was looking to hire a construction manager. Brendan introduced the representative to his father John Howard Adams, who was hired for the position — becoming John's final career managing financing and construction of public schools in the north-central part of New Mexico.
milestones: Born August 1, 1975, Oak Harbor, WA (Whidbey Island)
Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, University of Washington, Seattle (1998)
Master of Business Administration, University of New Mexico, Albuquerque (2003)
Father of Garret Adams (b. 10 Apr 2003) and Owen Adams (b. 3 Oct 2005)
Moved to Denver, CO (2006) — has lived there for 20 years
notes: Barbara says the meaning of Brendan was 'prince or king' and notes that St. Brendan was a voyager.
Spouse Megan Marie Adams born December 17, 1975
Paternal grandparents are Beryl Adams and George Francis Adams II
Explicit child-of relationship from John Howard Adams to Brendan McKeldin Adams.
Explicit parent in family_notes_adams_mckeldin: John Howard Adams
